**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

- [ ] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [ ] I have confirmed this bug exists on the latest released version of orthograph.
- [ ] (optional) I have confirmed this bug exists on the `main` branch of orthograph.

**Note**: Please provide a [minimal reproducible example](https://matthewrocklin.com/blog/work/2018/02/28/minimal-bug-reports) so we can reproduce the bug.

#### Code sample — a copy-pastable example

```python
# Your code here

```

#### Expected behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

#### Actual behavior
A clear and concise description of what actually happens, including any error messages or tracebacks.

#### Environment

- OS: [e.g. Ubuntu 22.04, macOS 14, Windows 11]
- Python version: [e.g. 3.12.3]
- orthograph version: [e.g. 1.2.0]
- Graph backend used: [e.g. NetworkX, Neo4j, Memgraph]

#### Additional context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. graph size, schema structure, relevant `pyproject.toml` extras).
